label: early original-phase step right after a v,3 bigram (weak, prefix-conjunction feature)
explanation: Fires only in the original phase and on the delimiter, mostly at t=3-5, and never in the copy phase. It is almost always the first occurrence of the input token. It is strongly enriched when the prefix contains v and 3, especially the bigram v 3 just before the step (prev_tok=3 has 12.6x lift, prev2_tok=v has 13.5x), and when the first token is m, g or y. Inputs l, 0, n, o, 1, 2 and <DEL> are also enriched. The strongest activations are at m v 3 [x] and similar. But it looks like a conjunction of specific prefix combinations, not one rule: the v-3 bigram predicate reaches only P=0.14 and R=0.15 on dev. Broad versions (v or 3 seen, early t, first occurrence, preferred input tokens) recover about 70% of mass at about 1.5% precision. Most steps after v 3 do not fire. Magnitude is roughly flat (median 0.12, max 0.23); the top examples begin m v 3.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=3 (+4.29), prev2_tok=v (+4.27), prev2_tok=3 (+3.81), prev2_tok=b (+3.68), prev3_tok=b (+3.34), orig2=v (+3.30). Lower it: phase=2 (-6.86), recall_idx=-1 (-0.52), out_tok=- (-0.52), phase=0 & out_tok=- (-0.52).
